name: kharrison Apps
subtitle: Personal apps, games, and projects
description: Personal projects by kharrison. Home to uTube, a custom YouTube client, and The Last Dragonrider, a pixel-art RPG. Discover new projects and get the latest releases here.

apps.name: uTube
apps.subtitle: Native YouTube viewing and commenting
apps.localizedDescription: A personal YouTube client with inline comments and replies, a YouTube inbox, Wall and Carousel Home layouts, AirPlay, background playback, downloads, and customizable controls. Light mode by default. Installs alongside Opaline as its own app; existing Opaline settings and sign-in do not transfer. Maintained by kharrison, based on Opaline by verback2308. For AltStore Classic.

versions.localizedDescription:
uTube by kharrison, based on Opaline by verback2308.

- uTube now installs as its own app alongside Opaline, using the separate com.kharrison.utube app identifier.
- The Open in uTube share action uses its own link handler so it opens uTube when both apps are installed.
- The kharrison Apps source now offers the standalone uTube build. Older builds that shared Opaline's identity are no longer offered in the source.
- Refreshed the GitHub page with uTube's features, icon, installation instructions, and credits. Removed upstream promotional and donation buttons.
- Jailbreak packages also use their own package ID and app folder.

Install uTube from the refreshed kharrison Apps source as a new app. You can keep Opaline or the older uTube installation. Settings, downloads, and sign-in from the older installation do not transfer automatically; connect your account in the new app. Future uTube updates use this new identity.

Wall, Carousel, inline comments, YouTube notifications, customizable controls, and AirPlay behavior remain available.

apps.name: The Last Dragonrider
apps.subtitle: A dragon-riding pixel RPG
apps.localizedDescription: Explore Emberfell with Corin and his dragon in this pixel-art adventure. The game is included in the app for offline single-player play, with persistent saves on your device. Existing Google cloud saves and story co-op are available online through the game's sign-in flow. Browser-local saves do not transfer automatically. For AltStore Classic on iPhone and iPad running iOS 15 or newer.

versions.localizedDescription:
The Last Dragonrider 1.0.1 by kharrison.

- New Corin and Aurelius silhouette icon, using the exact raised-wing pose from the game’s title screen.
- Matching artwork on your Home Screen and in AltStore.
- Offline single-player and device saves remain available.
- Full-screen native app, with bundled art, music and controls.
- Browser handoff for the existing Google account; cloud saves and story co-op require internet.

Existing browser-local saves are separate. Sync them with your Google account before moving to the app. Native Google sign-in and co-op still require confirmation on your device. Updating preserves app saves; removing the app removes device-only saves.
